# Angel Ade-Oduntan

> Operations strategist and UC Berkeley Haas MBA (Class of 2027). Operations and transformation, from diagnosis to adoption — redesigning how operations create value at scale in infrastructure-intensive businesses. Six years across power, telecom, industrial manufacturing, and banking.

This site has a human view (visual portfolio) and a machine view (Markdown). Every page is available as Markdown at the links below, by toggling the Human/Machine switch on any page, or by appending `?view=machine` to its URL.

- [About](/about.md): Longer narrative — background, approach, and where I'm heading
- [Writing](/writing.md): Reflections (mathematics, tennis, travel)
- [Selected Work](/selected-work.md): Personal projects and experiments (in progress)
